criteria.note: Generic, by-reference: snapshot_from_repo reuses build_spec_index/build_plan_index/resolve_status_map/tracker_for_repo; dir resolution identical to run_from_repo; no-config is a clean reconciled:False; grep clean of company/board literals.

FILE_STATUS_TO_WARP = dict(SPEC_STATUS_TO_WARP) then update with review->in_review, released->shipped (copy not mutation); the two added keys are absent from the shared constant so zero disagreement with the event mirror on shipped/blocked/ready; both extension values are in WARP_STATUSES.
Standalone specs -> task:{sid} (no epic segment, no collision with child:{epic}:{key} or epic:{pid}); find_epic/find_child never call _record (write audit does not grow after finds).

Idempotent + one-way (C1): writes only through the seam; indices byte-identical after two runs; byte-identical re-run. NOTE (finding 1): 'declared state wins' holds only when the declared status maps; an unmapped current status leaves an earlier mirror-set status standing (correct NG4 choice, but not absolute convergence).

One command: snapshot sub-parser -> _snapshot_cli in the repo-only module bin/warp routes jira to (bin/warp not in the 9651342 footprint); --dry-run offline; live path builds the provisioner and fails closed; bootstrap runs snapshot as the final step.

Selftest non-tautological; positive controls track the fixture (2 epics + 3 children incl 1 standalone, 3 transitions, 2 unset); four teeth reproduced RED with both modules sha256 unchanged, all non-vacuous.

findings.text: Finding 1: 'declared state wins' (AC5 prose) is conditional by design - for an item whose current declared status has no FILE_STATUS_TO_WARP entry, the snapshot leaves the board status untouched (not cleared), so if the event mirror earlier set a mapped status the board keeps it rather than converging. This is the correct NG4-safe choice; worth stating explicitly so it is not read as absolute convergence.

Finding 2: resolve_status_map is recomputed once per plan and once per spec (redundant, pure in-memory, far under the 500ms budget) and contributes to the review-lane cyclomatic-complexity note (24>20); hoisting it out of the loops would trim both. Optional.
Finding 3: shape gate review-lane (non-blocking, disclosed): snapshot_from_repo complexity 24, tracker_adapter.py 15% duplication - consistent with the WARP-0612 precedent.

Finding 4: the 'unset' counter conflates 'no file->WARP mapping' and 'WARP status not in the org status_map'; both are legitimately NG4-unset but the observability text attributes unset only to the former. Report-granularity nuance.

Finding 5 (theoretical only): a spec whose plan pointed at a filtered scaffold plan (PLAN-0000) would create a child under a non-existent epic key (the scaffold filter applies to the item's own id, not its parent-plan reference). No real spec references the template plan, so it cannot occur in practice.
